body.statement: Corollary (same-estimator consequence for the endpoint classes of \(\texttt{stat\_bdd\_thickness\_estimability\_frontier}\)). There is a finite constant \(C\), uniform over \(K\), such that for every \(\kappa\in K\) and all sufficiently large \(n\), the single total estimator \(\widehat\tau_n\), without knowledge of \(\kappa\) or the endpoint class, satisfies \[\sup_{P\in\mathrm{Iso}_\kappa}E_P\|\widehat\tau_n-\tau_P\|_\infty\leq Cn^{-1/(\kappa+2)},\qquad \sup_{P\in\mathrm{Perv}_\kappa}E_P\|\widehat\tau_n-\tau_P\|_\infty\leq C(\log n/n)^{1/(\kappa+2)}.\]
body.justification: The endpoint minimax orders are established in the banked \(\texttt{stat\_bdd\_thickness\_estimability\_frontier}\) result; this corollary records only the new simultaneous attainment consequence of Theorem 1.
body.gap: The banked result supplies separate endpoint procedures and minimax benchmarks, but not one total \(\kappa\)-free and profile-free estimator attaining both endpoint upper rates.
body.consumer: Analysts can use one causal boundary-curve procedure without selecting an isolated or pervasive support regime.
